<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def getP1():
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(tuple(1 if lines[r][c]=='B' else 0 for c in range(22,27)) for r in range(52,57))
def show(s): return '\n'.join(''.join('#' if v else '.' for v in row) for row in s)
print("before:", sum(map(sum,getP1())), "px")
for i in range(8):
    action(['UP'])
    s=getP1()
    print("after UP",i+1, sum(map(sum,s)),"px; step",current_frame.step)
print(show(getP1()))
</parameter>
</function>
